karuturi-gambella.changed: Dropped ct 'none'. Removed the final sentence 'Neither report records a condition attached to those loans.' Rest of the text kept.
karuturi-gambella.why: Both PDFs open and are the documents claimed (Part 4 'Unjust Enrichment', April 2017; Part 2 'Bankrolling India's Dirty Dozen', Dec 2016). All three quotes verified verbatim: 'to address the funding needs of a top performing bank' (Part 4), 'These investments were general in nature' (Part 2), '$40 million in general corporate loans' (Part 4, spelled 'Karaturi'). But neither report affirmatively states that no condition was attached; both say the opposite in general terms - IFC financial-sector clients 'are required to implement the institution's social and environmental Performance Standards' (Part 4) and the banks are 'contractually required to apply the Performance Standards' (Part 2). The why quote 'general in nature' describes unrestricted use of proceeds, not an absence of conditions, so it does not meet the 'none' bar.

asian-highway-karen-state.why: Document confirmed: ADB Project Administration Manual, Eindu to Kawkareik Road Improvement Project (46422-003), September 2015. Para 71(i) carries the REGDP quote verbatim under 'The Government will ensure that', and para 72 carries 'the resettlement coordinating committee has been set-up' verbatim as a precondition on relocation; para 88 says the relevant provisions are included in the loan agreement, so these are project-specific terms of this money rather than ADB's general Safeguard Policy Statement. lawpita-baluchaung-karenni.changed: Text kept in full. Dropped ct 'tied'.
lawpita-baluchaung-karenni.why: Every figure checks out on the page: loan 3,530 million yen (3,460 million disbursed), interest '2.50% p.a.', repayment '30 years ( 10 years )', procurement 'Partially Untied', Loan Agreement November 1987, borrower/executing agency Electric Power Corporation (EPC). But 'Partially Untied' does not support 'tied'. 'Tied' means the money must be spent with the lender country's own firms; the table's label says the procurement was untied, in part, and the page gives no statement that Japanese suppliers or contractors had to be used. A procurement label that reads 'untied' cannot be read as its opposite.

nagarhole-ecodevelopment-relocation.changed: Text and all three types kept. Removed the report number from the source title.
nagarhole-ecodevelopment-relocation.why: Document confirmed: World Bank Memorandum and Recommendation of the President on a proposed IDA credit and GEF grant to India for the Ecodevelopment Project, 3 August 1996. Para 39, 'Other Assurances Agreed at Negotiations', carries verbatim: 'submit first three microplans in each PA for approval by IDA'; 'implement a program for people living within the PAs, including voluntary relocation, in accordance with project guidelines'; 'not cause or undertake involuntary resettlement in the project PAs'; 'ensure that project activities would not erode the customary tenure rights of tribals'. 'implementation would require prior Bank approval' is verbatim at para 33 on voluntary relocation. The entry says the government 'agreed' these at negotiations, which is what the document supports; it does not overclaim them as conditions of effectiveness. Report number dropped because the page's number reads as P69531N, not the P-6947-IN given in the source title, and I could not resolve which is right.

southern-peru-ilo-smelter-toquepala.why: FRUS 1952-1954 vol IV doc 693, Minutes of the 217th NAC meeting, Washington, 26 October 1954, confirms all of it. Footnote 4 records the no-objection action of 1 November 1954 (NAC Action No. 733), a loan 'not to exceed $100 million' on 'not more than a 50-50 basis'; the minutes carry 'the Bank's loan would be the senior obligation of the borrower', 'the borrower would be required to guarantee completion of the project to the Bank', 'repayment of principal would begin 5 years after the loan and be made over a 15-year period', and 'the applicant for the loan had not indicated whether such a guaranty would be an acceptable condition'. The entry already marks these as terms put to the council rather than final terms. 'fincov' holds: the 50-50 limit on the bank's share is a required self-financing ratio.
